english.title: Use on a road a locomotive / motor tractor / bus no conspicuous external nearside marking of its unladen weight
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[locomotive,]_
(B)_[motor tractor,]_
(C)_[bus,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which did not have its unladen weight plainly marked in a conspicuous place on the outside of the vehicle on its nearside
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 71(2)(a) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See Regulation 71(1) for exceptions
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) In the Statement of Facts if the weight was displayed, but in the wrong fashion, the place and mode of display should be included.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H302 and H311.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when the unladen weight of the vehicle was not plainly marked in a conspicuous place on the outside of the vehicle on its nearside .

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
